headline: Skyworks posts agentic AMS platform roles with verification-data integration and evaluation
fact: Skyworks listed a Cedar Rapids AI/software-workflow co-op on August 20 and a central automation role on August 24 for an agentic AMS design/verification platform. The latter assigns encoding analog/RF practice into tool-connected flows and engineering distributed simulation/verification data; Verilog-A/SV-RNM model creation and validation are desired experience. September 24 Irvine co-op 78496 assigns agent tool use, retrieval and evaluation against real testbenches, logs, waveforms and coverage to support mixed-signal debug and closure. These platform-development advertisements do not establish deployment or a shared team across roles.

sources.title: Skyworks Careers: AI Automation & Software Developer Co-op (Winter/Spring 2027), requisition 78222
sources.summary: Official posting start date is August 20, 2026; the work term is January–June 2027. The current title and duties concern AI/software workflow development, with HDL and behavioral modeling as desired background; the URL retains an older title.

sources.title: Sr. Design Automation Engineer
sources.summary: Official August 24 role 77976 describes a central team, encoding analog/RF circuit practice into agent-connected flows, distributed engineering data, and desired experience creating/verifying Verilog-A and SV-RNM models. Rechecked October 25; requirements are not measured platform results.

sources.title: Skyworks Careers: Agentic Mixed Signal Verification Platform Winter/Spring Co-Op, requisition 78496
sources.summary: Official September 24 role 78496 remains available. It assigns agent evaluation against real verification artifacts and quality reporting; January-June 2027 is the proposed work term. It does not establish a shared platform/team with the other postings.
